actionTitle.message: RepoShout — send this GitHub page's title and URL to X's composer

commandShareToX.message: Send the current GitHub page's title and URL to X's composer

shareButtonLabel.description: Text on the button added to GitHub pages. Keep it short; it sits next to Fork and Star.

shareButtonTooltip.message: Send this page's title and URL to X's composer
shareButtonTooltip.description: Tooltip on the in-page Share button.

shareButtonAria.description: Accessible name of the in-page Share button.

noticeCredential.message: This page's title or URL may contain sensitive authentication information, so the X composer was not opened. Nothing was sent to X.
noticeCredential.description: Shown when sharing is refused because the page title or the URL matches one of the credential patterns. Must not include the title, the URL or any value.

noticeUnsupported.message: This page cannot be shared. Nothing was sent to X.
noticeUnsupported.description: Shown when the page is out of scope (settings, authentication, non-GitHub). Must not include the URL.
